title: addTypeDetails
summary: Add token type details to tokenized documents.

gpu_support.notes: `addTypeDetails` classifies host-resident text tokens and updates tokenizedDocument metadata; it does not use provider kernels.

description: `addTypeDetails(documents)` detects token types in a RunMat `tokenizedDocument` compatibility object and returns an updated object. `addTypeDetails(documents,'DiscardKnownValues',tf)` controls whether existing type details are preserved or recomputed. `addTypeDetails(documents,'TopLevelDomains',domains)` customizes web-address type recognition.
behaviors: When type details are absent, RunMat derives one type value for each token and stores the details on the returned object.
`DiscardKnownValues` defaults to `false`, so existing known type details are preserved while missing or `unknown` type details are filled.

`TopLevelDomains` accepts a character vector, string array, or cell array of character vectors. It overrides the document's stored TLD list for web-address type recognition and is stored on the returned object.

RunMat recognizes `letters`, `digits`, `punctuation`, `email-address`, `web-address`, `hashtag`, `at-mention`, `emoticon`, `emoji`, and `other` using the same lightweight token rules as `tokenizedDocument`.
Custom token-type tables, full MathWorks `topLevelDomains` corpus parity, and exact MathWorks URL classifier parity remain broader Text Analytics work.

faqs.question: Does `addTypeDetails` support `TopLevelDomains`?
faqs.answer: Yes. RunMat accepts character, string-array, and cell-string TLD lists for web-address detection. Full default `topLevelDomains` corpus parity remains tracked.

faqs.question: Does `addTypeDetails` execute on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It classifies host token strings and updates object metadata.

example.input:
updatedDocuments = addTypeDetails(documents)
updatedDocuments = addTypeDetails(documents, 'DiscardKnownValues', tf)
updatedDocuments = addTypeDetails(documents, 'TopLevelDomains', domains)

points: `tf` must be a logical scalar; numeric and integer 0/1 values are rejected.
`domains` must contain one or more valid top-level-domain labels.
Use `tokenDetails(updatedDocuments)` to view the resulting type table.

gpu_residency: `addTypeDetails` updates host tokenizedDocument metadata and has no provider kernel.
